selection: Same original six development maps for all checkpoints; compare final checkpoints only; preserve all seeds and outcomes. Curriculum training changes goal distribution and does not isolate short tasks from obstacle interaction.
terminal_definition: all agents simultaneously within 4m of goal below 2m/s; any collision terminates
notes: Exploratory comparison with original 100k-step Standard MASAC; no candidate arm; no conclusion about novelty, safety, convergence or final generalization.
curriculum_rule: On reset: short_edge keeps original starts and sets each goal to its start, then goal_y += 40 when start_y <= 120, else goal_y -= 40; full uses original reset goals. Stage chosen by completed environment steps at episode reset; episodes crossing a stage threshold finish before switching.
